notes: Compatibility shims document legacy authority paths that may remain during migration. They must be read/write classified and removed when the target transition boundary is live.

shims.read_permission: Allowed only inside AppState focus compatibility helpers while panel-local focus_shape authority migration remains incomplete.
shims.write_permission: Write only from AppState focus compatibility helpers after the active panel focus_shape has been updated.
shims.removal_trigger: AppState focus helpers no longer need a ViewContext.focused_window compatibility fallback.
shims.follow_up_task: Remove the focused-window compatibility carrier once panel-local focus commits fully cover active-focus recovery.
shims.qa_enforcement: check_appstate_contract.py validates shim coverage and links it to an existing transition id.

shims.read_permission: Allowed only inside display render projection helpers or bounds-correction code after identity restore has run.
shims.write_permission: Never write authoritative selection from display render projection helper calculations.
shims.removal_trigger: Display render projection helpers accept explicit projection inputs and no longer inspect restore authority fields directly.
shims.follow_up_task: Remove render-derived row compatibility helpers once render callers carry explicit projection state.
shims.qa_enforcement: check_appstate_contract.py requires render shims to declare no-write authority and target transition linkage.
